item.question: What challenges are associated with high-dimensional data in feature selection?
item.answer: High-dimensional data can lead to increased training time, algorithmic complexity, storage space issues, and noise in datasets. These challenges are collectively known as the 'curse of dimensionality,' which complicates the process of selecting relevant features without losing accuracy.
